chapters.title: Weather Conditions of last 24 hours & Next 72 hours
chapters.subtitle: Recorded Rainfall (Last 24 hours)
chapters.description:
This briefing covers the current monsoon situation, including the record of the last 24 hours and the forecast of the next 72 hours. This data is sourced from both open-source weather layers and PMD ground sensors. This supports a proactive approach to disaster mitigation where needed.

The comprehensive monitoring system integrates real-time observations with advanced forecasting models to provide accurate precipitation tracking and early warning capabilities across Pakistan's diverse geographical regions.

**🗺️ Getting Started:** Scroll down to begin.
